newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks fall as trade data rattles market.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks fall as trade data rattles market.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended lower Wednesday as news that imports surged while foreign sales of American-made goods fell in July raised questions about the strength of the economy and whether the Federal Reserve will need to raise interest rates.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended down 11.47 points at 5,877.36. In the broader market, declining issues led advances 13-9 on moderate volume of 393 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
